headline: Log4j 1.x global appender contention: {N} threads BLOCKED in WriterAppender
detail: Log4j 1.x synchronises log writes on the appender's monitor. Under high request rates, every logging worker contends for the same monitor and BLOCKS — converting a logging call from a few microseconds into hundreds of milliseconds. The application has no functional bug; logging itself is the bottleneck.
remediation: Migrate to Log4j 2 / SLF4J with an async appender (DisruptorAppender, Log4j2 AsyncLogger). At minimum, downgrade log level on hot paths and stop logging at INFO for every request. Confirm with a follow-up dump that BLOCKED count drops.
